lines.1: 「Fine. Then for my special talent, I'll show you a screaming magic trick with a spicy kick.」
lines.2: 「Huh? I'll settle for an extra-large curry with no carrots.」
lines.3: 「Never mind that. Just get into that locker. This trick is guaranteed to make you scream.」
lines.5: Impressed, Crab climbed into the locker.
lines.7: 「It won't. Now, I'm closing the door.」
lines.8: 「Then I'll brace the door shut with this mop. That way, the locker can't be opened from the inside.」
lines.9: 「Right. And now you do a trick that lets me escape?」
lines.10: 「Next, I go home. If nobody else has shown up by now, I guess there's no student council work today.」
lines.12: 「You can't get out. Think about it, idiot.」
lines.17: 「You stole my lunch today. This is payback.」
lines.18: 「Urk... You noticed? Come on, a little bite didn't hurt!」
lines.20: 「You left me the rice balls and ate every single side dish.」
lines.21: 「And while we're at it, you could've at least washed the chopsticks.」
lines.22: 「D-Don't screw with me! Let me out!」
lines.23: 「See? I told you the trick would make you scream.」
lines.24: Tormenting Crab made me feel a little better.
lines.26: Knowing that idiot, she would come up with some way to retaliate.
lines.27: And when she did, I'd pay her back double.
